title: Per-routine spec (generated by bin/gen_spec)
description: Fortran facts about one routine plus the JS roles the conventions project from. See spec/README.md.

package.description: Reference source directory (F7); null when the source is not vendored.

kind.description: S11: INFO; a FUNCTION's value; else the last output array (BLAS/stdlib style).

quickReturn.description: Top-level early returns after the argument checks, in source order.

sets.description: Fortran assignments executed before returning, verbatim.

untranslated.description: Expressions outside the translator's grammar (js is null there).

notes.description: Facts the generator could not derive (Appendix A gaps, undocumented arguments, ...).

overrides.description: Applied spec/overrides entries, with their reasons.

js.description: JS over the routine's JS parameter names; helpers max, min, abs, trunc, real, imag. null = untranslated.

fortran.description: Fortran dummy argument; null for synthetic params.

role.description: matrix/banded: 2-D with an LD; packed: 1-D triangle (format packed|rfp); vector: 1-D data; index: 1-D INTEGER; workspace: WORK-family scratch; flag: CHARACTER option; dim: size; ld/inc/lwork: consumed by strides/length; info: returned (in/out INFO also enters as infoIn); state: reverse-communication state (IDO); result: complex FUNCTION output.

of.description: ld/inc/lwork: the Fortran array it belongs to.

element.description: scalar: callers pass an element of one of their arrays, read or updated in place, so it crosses as `x, offsetX` (S10). Set only by an override.

dims.description: Declared Fortran extents (rank from the declaration, extents from the doc comment).

ld.description: Fortran LD argument of a 2-D array.

info.description: Fortran INFO value (negative: LAPACK -k; positive: reference BLAS k).

values.description: Canonical JS strings (spec/options.json); null when Appendix A has no mapping.

js.description: Rejection condition (guard included) in JS; null = untranslated.

rowMajor.description: Leading-dimension checks only: the rejection condition for row-major storage, on the array's column count (CONVENTIONS V5). Absent when the array is square (one condition for both layouts); null when the column count is not established (column-major check only).
